full_page.content:
1936, November
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 148 Cont.
Nov. 3 Victoria Mijewisk - 30 - operation teeth hemoraging.
Anthony Bysetzke - 27 - Ep. Fits for six yrs. fearing it was effect- ing mind come two weeks ago and enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc. $5. Thank God is just wonderfully improving-Ep. Fits, Pray they they may not return.
Mrs. Leona Podsiadly - 27 - pyrea now .. .had accident 9 August not expected to live - O.K. now ...
4th Vincent Griffith - 38 - T.B. in H. Kiefer
Mary Grace O'Rourke - 32 - trained nurse now on back 3 yrs. Carried out and brought here To-day from Port Huron ... Wants to devote her life to the sick ... if cured ....
Page 149
Nov. 4 Ralph Cozadd of Wayne Mich. - 2 yrs. - parents Methodists - never sat up - never spoke - brought her last August - 2 weeks later started to eat without crying ... notices now quite well ...... Eczema gone too .....
Cecilia Kudzin - 20 - brain tuomer here To-day ... patient resigned ... Mrs. M. Maher from Penne. - heart - mouth.
Mrs. Mason - 30 - eczema
5th Grace Vinazzo - 50 - tuomer removed ... still poorly
9th Mrs. Helen Tait - and family - child strike - very rude - Her neigh- bor asks for prayers.
Walter Sommers - 19 - lutheran - eyes .... crossed
Hattie Jacobs - 38 - Jewess, nerveous. ..
John McCabe - about 75 - dying of cancer - baptized him conditionally To-night.
Wm Szprywa - 32 - insane - in Eloise.
Page 150 Nov. 11 Catherine Kelcoure - 45 - in Eloise - was dying of cancer - prayed for and enrolled - Expects to come home To-night - Cured.
